description: This Java class, VisitTypeEditor, is a custom property editor for the VisitType class within the OpenMRS project. It extends OpenmrsPropertyEditor and overrides methods to retrieve VisitType objects by ID or UUID via the visit service. The class facilitates conversion between string identifiers and VisitType objects, enabling easier data binding and form processing in the application.

classes.name: VisitTypeEditor
classes.description: Custom property editor for VisitType objects, extending OpenmrsPropertyEditor to provide conversion methods by ID and UUID.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a VisitType object given its integer ID by calling the visit service.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a VisitType object given its UUID string by calling the visit service.
